title: Beyond a Single Sentiment Score: Topical and Affective Dimensions of Emoji Meaning on Twitter
summary: The paper argues that representing an emoji by a single sentiment scalar collapses two dissociable dimensions of meaning: how topically coherent its contexts are and how affectively dispersed its crowd-sourced ratings are. It introduces 'stability delta', the within-class minus between-class mean cosine similarity of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings of emoji-free tweet text, computes it for the 62 emojis with at least 15 occurrences in the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset, and correlates it with external per-emoji affect-dispersion measures. The headline result is a positive Spearman correlation with Kralj Novak sentiment variance (rho = +0.361, Holm p = 0.015, n = 59) corroborated by Ferre 2025 strongly-evoked-emotion counts (rho = +0.509, p = 0.0003, n = 47), with a saturated (>0.97 macro F1) sarcasm classifier reported only as supporting evidence.

match_target.why: It is the paper's explicit primary test and headline result, and it is the cheapest: no model training at all, just the ESD corpus, MiniLM sentence embeddings, the emosent-py lexicon, and a Spearman correlation over 59 emoji-level points. Appendix E states the whole pipeline regenerates in ~3 minutes on a CPU. Any reproduction that gets rho near +0.36 with Holm-corrected significance has reproduced the paper's central claim.

tolerance.why: Rule 3: the target is a bounded rank correlation (Spearman rho) computed on a small emoji panel (n = 59), and the paper prints it as a fraction (0.361), not a percentage, so the band is 0.02 absolute. Rule 1 does not apply because the paper gives bootstrap CIs and a jackknife range, not a standard deviation over repeated runs, and Rule 2 does not apply because this is not an accuracy-like % on a 2,000+ example test set.

requirements.stmt: English filtering keeps only tweets with at least 85% ASCII alphabetic characters, which must remove 272 tweets from the 16,859 raw inputs (leaving 16,587).
requirements.quote: The English filter retains tweets with at least 85% ASCII alphabetic characters

requirements.stmt: All downstream NLP (VADER scoring, sentence embeddings) must run on the emoji-stripped clean_text field, never on raw text.
requirements.quote: which has all emoji removed and serves as the input to all downstream NLP components

requirements.stmt: Only emojis with at least 15 occurrences are retained as the analytical panel; this must yield 62 emojis covering 15,569 tweets from the 16,575-tweet corpus.
requirements.quote: Retaining emojis with at least 15 occurrences leaves 62 emojis covering 15,569 embedded tweets.

requirements.stmt: Sentence embeddings must come from all-MiniLM-L6-v2, producing 384-dimensional L2-normalised vectors.
For each emoji, the within-class similarity set is the tweets in which that emoji is the primary emoji (sample up to 100); the between-class set is 500 random tweets from the rest of the corpus.
requirements.quote: For each emoji e with at least 15 occurrences, let Te be the set of tweets in which e is the primary emoji.

requirements.stmt: Within-class similarity averages cosine over ordered pairs i != j (self-similarity excluded); between-class similarity averages over the 100 x 500 cross pairs; delta = W_e - B_e.
requirements.quote: where i, j index tweets containing e and k indexes the random comparison set.

requirements.stmt: The Kralj Novak dispersion target must be the variance of the three probabilities (p_neg, p_neu, p_pos), not the scalar sentiment score.
requirements.quote: Kralj Novak sentiment variance: variance of (pneg, pneu, ppos).

requirements.stmt: Significance must come from a permutation test with 10,000 permutations (plus percentile and BCa bootstrap CIs over 10,000 resamples), not from asymptotic p-values alone.
requirements.quote: Evaluates monotonic relationships using both asymptotic and empirical permutation p-values (10,000 permutations).

requirements.stmt: Delta vs Kralj Novak variance is the primary test and p-values are Holm-corrected across the family of four Kralj Novak tests.
requirements.quote: For the four primary correlations involving Kralj Novak data, we select ∆vs. Kralj Novak variance as the primary test

requirements.stmt: A partial Spearman controlling for emoji frequency must be reported; for the primary test it should be about +0.370 (frequency is not the driver).
requirements.quote: partial ρ controlling for emoji frequency = +0.3700

requirements.stmt: All three classifiers use the same stratified five-fold split with random state 42 on the 16,587-tweet English-filtered partition; results are reported as mean +/- SD over folds.
requirements.quote: We run three classifiers under identical stratified five-fold cross-validation (random state = 42) on the English-filtered Twitter partition (n = 16,587)

requirements.stmt: The centroid-distance (structural) features must be recomputed inside each training fold, never fitted once on the full dataset.
requirements.quote: centroid distance features are recomputed within each training fold rather than once on the full dataset

requirements.stmt: VADER must be scored on emoji-free text so that VADER's built-in emoji lexicon cannot leak emoji identity into the features.
requirements.quote: VADER is now scored on emoji-free clean text (avoiding contamination from VADER’s built-in emoji lexicon)
